free_remote_compute_assessment.route: Remote bulk copying using Hugging Face CPU/Docker Spaces
free_remote_compute_assessment.reason: Current official documentation requires a paid personal plan to create ordinary Gradio or Docker compute Spaces. The nominal CPU Basic hourly price is free but does not remove that plan requirement. No paid plan or compute service was enabled.
free_remote_compute_assessment.note: The documented free ZeroGPU allowance was not repurposed to avoid the ordinary compute plan requirement for a bulk archival job.

codespaces_assessment.reason: The existing GitHub CLI authorization lacks codespace and user billing scopes; browser GitHub is signed out. No account-specific remaining allowance or enforceable zero-charge cap was confirmed. No compute resources or paid plan were enabled. A free-compute allowance alone would not establish enough free durable storage for the entire current PMC corpus.

unresolved.reason: The official checkpoint repository requires institutional access unavailable to this account. No accessible public copy of either original checkpoint was found. Public 1.1 and SPECTRA checkpoints differ.
